The readable rooftop plane surrounds her; the near token and hand are conspicuously enlarged, while head, torso, bent limbs, table edge, and distant parapet follow coherent top-down foreshortening and rapid 0.5x near-to-far scale change. Cosmetic rose pigment begins visibly on both high cheekbones and continues upward-outward toward both temples, with soft tapered edges and a stable hue distinct from contour or cast shadow. Her lips retain natural ridges beneath a continuous glossy film with clean curved wet highlights and slightly richer inner color, without candy, fruit, syrup, or food props. Direct compact flash mixes with warm work bulbs and cool blue-hour ambient light; one unfinished sorting action keeps the scene candid.
